verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies this capability. Skills are discovered from the repo or home directory, custom agents are defined through configuration, and the GitHub integration sets up a workflow in the repo. Together these suggest automation definitions can live in version control and be reviewed and reverted with normal git tooling, but OpenCode ships no first-party way to do this. Missing for 10: documented versioning of agents/skills/workflows, a built-in review flow for automation changes, rollback of automation definitions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
